typeSummaries.meaning: MVRV (market value ÷ realised value, i.e. the close ÷ the average on-chain cost basis) closed below 1.0, from at or above 1.0 the day before: the close is below the average on-chain cost basis.
MVRV (market value ÷ realised value, i.e. the close ÷ the average on-chain cost basis) closed back at or above 1.0, from below 1.0 the day before.

MVRV (market value ÷ realised value, i.e. the close ÷ the average on-chain cost basis) closed above 3.5, from at or below 3.5 the day before: the close is more than 3.5 times the average on-chain cost basis.
MVRV (market value ÷ realised value, i.e. the close ÷ the average on-chain cost basis) closed back at or below 3.5, from above 3.5 the day before.
The share of supply whose creation price is below the close fell below 50%, from at or above 50% the day before: most coins are held below their creation price.
The share of supply whose creation price is below the close closed back at or above 50%, from below 50% the day before.

7-day short-term-holder SOPR (value spent ÷ value at creation, outputs younger than 150 days, over a week) crossed from below 1 to at or above 1: in aggregate, short-term holders' spent coins moved at or above their creation value.

7-day short-term-holder SOPR (value spent ÷ value at creation, outputs younger than 150 days, over a week) crossed from at or above 1 to below 1: in aggregate, short-term holders' spent coins moved below their creation value.

The symbol's daily close crossed above the realised price (realised cap ÷ supply: the average on-chain cost basis): on the day before it was below it, on this day at or above it. Compared against the symbol's own stored daily close: DWLF decides it from that close and the level on this day and the day before.

The symbol's daily close crossed below the realised price (realised cap ÷ supply: the average on-chain cost basis): on the day before it was at or above it, on this day below it. Compared against the symbol's own stored daily close: DWLF decides it from that close and the level on this day and the day before.

The symbol's daily close crossed above the STH realised price (the cost basis of outputs younger than 150 days): on the day before it was below it, on this day at or above it. Compared against the symbol's own stored daily close: DWLF decides it from that close and the level on this day and the day before.

The symbol's daily close crossed below the STH realised price (the cost basis of outputs younger than 150 days): on the day before it was at or above it, on this day below it. Compared against the symbol's own stored daily close: DWLF decides it from that close and the level on this day and the day before.

The symbol's daily close crossed above the LTH realised price (the cost basis of outputs 150 days and older): on the day before it was below it, on this day at or above it. Compared against the symbol's own stored daily close: DWLF decides it from that close and the level on this day and the day before.

The symbol's daily close crossed below the LTH realised price (the cost basis of outputs 150 days and older): on the day before it was at or above it, on this day below it. Compared against the symbol's own stored daily close: DWLF decides it from that close and the level on this day and the day before.

The supply held by addresses holding at least 1,000 BTC: its 30-day change crossed above its trailing-365-day 95th percentile (days strictly before this one). An address cohort, not entities: exchange and custodian wallets dominate it, and wallet consolidation moves it with no change of owner.

The supply held by addresses holding at least 1,000 BTC: its 30-day change crossed below its trailing-365-day 5th percentile (days strictly before this one). An address cohort, not entities: exchange and custodian wallets dominate it, and wallet consolidation moves it with no change of owner.

The supply held by addresses holding at least 10,000 BTC: its 30-day change crossed above its trailing-365-day 95th percentile (days strictly before this one). An address cohort, not entities: exchange and custodian wallets dominate it, and wallet consolidation moves it with no change of owner.

The supply held by addresses holding at least 10,000 BTC: its 30-day change crossed below its trailing-365-day 5th percentile (days strictly before this one). An address cohort, not entities: exchange and custodian wallets dominate it, and wallet consolidation moves it with no change of owner.

The supply held by outputs (UTXOs) of at least 1,000 BTC: its 30-day change crossed above its trailing-365-day 95th percentile (days strictly before this one). An output (UTXO) cohort, not entities: one owner can hold many outputs, and consolidating or splitting them moves it with no change of owner.

The supply held by outputs (UTXOs) of at least 1,000 BTC: its 30-day change crossed below its trailing-365-day 5th percentile (days strictly before this one). An output (UTXO) cohort, not entities: one owner can hold many outputs, and consolidating or splitting them moves it with no change of owner.

The BTC value of spent outputs at least 5 years old was above its trailing-365-day 99th percentile (days strictly before this one). The amounts are exact chain records; calling the day a spike is statistical. It records that old coins moved, not who moved them or why.

The BTC value of spent outputs at least 10 years old was above its trailing-365-day 99th percentile (days strictly before this one). The amounts are exact chain records; calling the day a spike is statistical. It records that old coins moved, not who moved them or why.

Coin-days destroyed (value × age, over every spent output) was above its trailing-365-day 99th percentile (days strictly before this one). The amounts are exact chain records; calling the day a spike is statistical.

The day's activity in transactions whose inputs total at least 1,000 BTC was above its trailing-365-day 99th percentile (days strictly before this one). The amounts are exact chain records; calling the day a spike is statistical. Gross: change and exchange-internal moves count. Transactions, not entities: it says nothing about who sent them.
The share of all bitcoin held in addresses whose public key is already on-chain has risen above a whole percentage point (e.g. 36 %).
The share of all bitcoin held in addresses whose public key is already on-chain has fallen below a whole percentage point (e.g. 36 %).
Exposed bitcoin has fallen at least 3 % in 30 days: coins are leaving addresses with a visible key.
The 30-day fall in exposed bitcoin has eased back above -1.5 %.
At least 1 BTC of pay-to-public-key coins untouched for 10+ years moved today (often Satoshi-era mining rewards).
At least 100 BTC of coins untouched for 10+ years moved today from ordinary (hashed) addresses whose public key was already visible because the address had spent before.
The network's 7-day hash rate is 20% or more below its all-time high.
Ended: has recovered to within 10% of its high.
The 7-day hash rate fell 15% or more over 30 days.
Ended: 30-day change back above -5%.
Hash ribbon capitulation: 30-day average hash rate fell below the 60-day average (miners switching off).
Ended: 30-day average back above the 60-day (by 0.5 %).
Puell multiple below 0.5: miners' daily issuance revenue is less than half its 1-year average.
Ended: Puell back to 0.75 or more.
Puell multiple above 4: miners' daily issuance revenue is over 4x its 1-year average.
Ended: Puell back to 3.5 or less.
Fees are 10 % or more of miners' block rewards over 7 days (block space in demand).
Ended: fee share back under 7 %.
Fees are under 1 % of miners' block rewards over 7 days.
Ended: fee share back to 1.5 % or more.
One mining pool found 30 % or more of the last ~week's blocks (1,008).
Ended: the largest pool is back under 25 %.
One mining pool found 40 % or more of the last ~week's blocks.
Ended: the largest pool is back under 35 %.
The three largest pools found half or more of the last ~week's blocks.
Ended: top three back under 47 %.
Mining-pool concentration (Herfindahl index of the last ~week's blocks) reached 0.15 or more.
Pool concentration fell back below 0.14.
Mining-pool concentration (Herfindahl index of the last ~week's blocks) reached 0.18 or more — 'highly concentrated' under the 2023 US merger guidelines.
Pool concentration fell back below 0.17.
Hashprice (what a petahash of mining earns per day, in USD, from subsidy plus fees) hit its lowest level in a year: miner margins are squeezed.
A difficulty adjustment happened (every 2,016 blocks); value = size of the change.
Difficulty fell 5 % or more at a retarget (hash rate left the network).
Difficulty rose 10 % or more at a retarget.
Cheap block space: the median fee has been under 1 sat/vB for 12 blocks in a row (~2 h); a window to consolidate UTXOs or batch payments.
The cheap-fee window closed: the median fee was 1 sat/vB or more for 3 blocks.
Cheap block space: the median fee has been under 2 sat/vB for 12 blocks in a row (~2 h); a window to consolidate UTXOs or batch payments.
The cheap-fee window closed: the median fee was 2 sat/vB or more for 3 blocks.
Cheap block space: the median fee has been under 5 sat/vB for 12 blocks in a row (~2 h); a window to consolidate UTXOs or batch payments.
The cheap-fee window closed: the median fee was 5 sat/vB or more for 3 blocks.
Fee spike: the 6-block median fee jumped to 4x or more the previous week's median (and at least 2 sat/vB).
The fee spike faded: below 2x the weekly median for 6 blocks.
A sustained backlog: blocks have been full for about a day while even their cheapest transactions paid 3x the recent fee floor and at least 2 sat/vB.
The backlog cleared: over the last day, cheap transactions got in again (or blocks were not full) in two of every three blocks.
Price has risen back above the average purchase price of a regular-purchase cohort (e.g. 'weekly since 2019'): that cohort is back in profit.
Price has fallen below the average purchase price of a regular-purchase cohort (e.g. 'weekly since 2019'): that cohort is now at a loss.
BRK's Capital Sentiment phase changed (raw, day to day). Phases place price against four references.

Capital Sentiment phase 'Above all four, all-coin cost above trend' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is at or above all four references, and the all-coin cost basis is above the 1-year average. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.

Capital Sentiment phase 'Above all four' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is at or above all four references. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.

Capital Sentiment phase 'Above short-term cost, under trend' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is at or above the short-term holders' cost basis but below the 1-year average. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.

Capital Sentiment phase 'Under short-term cost, above trend' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is below the short-term holders' cost basis but at or above the 1-year average. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.

Capital Sentiment phase 'Above short-term cost and trend' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is at or above the short-term holders' cost basis and the 1-year average, but below a long-run cost basis. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.

Capital Sentiment phase 'Under short-term cost only' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is below the short-term holders' cost basis and at or above the other three references. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.

Capital Sentiment phase 'Between: two of four above' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is below the short-term holders' cost basis, with exactly two of the four references above it. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.

Capital Sentiment phase 'Below all four, long-term cost above all-coin' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is below all four references, and the long-term holders' cost basis is above the all-coin one. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.

Capital Sentiment phase 'Below all four' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is below all four references. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.

Capital Sentiment phase 'Slipping under long-run references' has held 3 days running (confirmed): The short-term holders' cost basis is the highest reference and price is below trend or a long-run cost basis; or price is below three of the four. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.
